title: Faith begins where comfort ends.
paragraphs:
Peter did something the other disciples never attempted.
He stepped out of the boat.

The storm didn’t stop.
The waves didn’t calm.
The wind didn’t disappear.
Yet for a moment, faith carried him where fear said he couldn’t go.
But the moment Peter focused on the storm instead of Jesus… he began to sink.
Many believers want miracle faith without leaving the boat of comfort.
But the kingdom of God often begins where safety ends.
Jesus is still asking the same question today:
Will you stay in the boat… or step toward Him?
“Be honest… if you were in the boat that night, would you have stepped out?”
